entries.title: v0.2.6
entries.note: Hotfix for the desktop app. Group chats open again in a team imported by 0.2.2 or earlier. Those imports did not copy each group's own conversation, so a click on the group did nothing. At start, the app now copies the missing conversations from the DSH home the team came from; your old DSH home is only read. ( #551 , #837 )

entries.title: v0.2.5
entries.note: Renamed to DS Bot. The desktop app and its downloads are now called DS Bot; your team, chats, settings and browser data carry over when you update. Group chats: no relay limit; @ calls in one message start all the named members at once, and the calling Bot waits until all of them finish; a member that only says "Got it" goes straight on to its tools. How Bots work: Bots hand parallel work to other Bots instead of starting DSH subagents. In a private chat, a message you send while the Bot is working reaches it right away. Crash & data fixes: fixed the Linux image crash, the part-switch loop on repeated model errors, lost Bot-to-Bot messages across restarts or failed deliveries, outside edits to state.json being overwritten, folder guard bypasses, and secrets missing after a restart. 30+ more fixes across group folders and notices, memory review and Chinese recall, voice input, usage s

entries.title: v0.2.4
entries.note: Privacy Bot: a Bot can be marked private; other Bots cannot read its folder, memory or chats, and sharing needs your approval. Bots can read, check and edit Word, PowerPoint and Excel documents. A Bot can propose a new skill or an AGENTS.md update after long work; applied only when you approve. Group details can stop all work in the group at once. The sidebar can be dragged to resize or folded to an avatar rail; narrow windows fold the Bot panel first. Bot views run on the shared Deep View package. Fixes: group-name tooltip on truncated names, read_group_chat on notice rows, installer writable-folder check. DS Bot tracks DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.4.

entries.title: v0.2.3
entries.note: Added The desktop app keeps running in the system tray when you close its window, so Bots go on with their work. Click the tray icon to open the window again, or choose Quit there to end the app. ( #500 , #549 ) An avatar library in Bot settings and New Bot: import several photos at once and reuse them for any Bot. If some files fail, the others are still imported. ( #484 , #491 ) When a Bot hands its browser to you for a sign-in, a payment or a check, a card in the chat lets you take over, skip it, or tell the Bot you're done. ( #591 ) A message you steer into a running turn shows "Not read yet" under it until the Bot reads it. ( #581 , #598 ) Old /btw cards left by 0.2.1 can be deleted from the chat.
